notes: Purchase: Cash Invoice from a photo - take or choose a photo of a shop bill (or paste its text from Google Lens); bill no, date, shop, total and every item line (rate, qty, amount) are read, matched to your Item Master and shown for checking; confirm adds one cash purchase per line with the rate as its landing. Settings > Company & Admin: a free OCR.space key for photo reading (the shared demo key is often busy).
